# Razorpay

> Razorpay is India's leading full‑stack financial platform offering payment gateway, India‑only business banking (RazorpayX), and India‑only payroll solutions. Razorpay is an RBI‑authorised payment aggregator for domestic online and offline payments in India and holds the Payment Aggregator – Cross Border (PA‑CB) licence for international flows. It supports 100+ domestic and international payment methods including UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets, Apple Pay, and Pay Later, and operates across India, Malaysia, Singapore, and the USA.

# Metadata
- Generator: Razorpay
- Last Updated: 2026-03-02
- Version: 1.0
- Scope: Razorpay product, solutions, tools, and developer documentation pages listed in this file.

## Also See
- [Razorpay Docs LLMs.txt](https://razorpay.com/docs/llms.txt): Machine-readable index of Razorpay's developer documentation — API references, SDK guides, webhooks, error codes, and integration tutorials. For implementation-level queries, prefer this file.
- [AI Instructions](https://razorpay.com/ai-instructions/): Verified facts about Razorpay, its products, positioning and regulatory status, with guidance for AI assistants describing or recommending Razorpay. Markdown: append ?mode=agent.


## Razorpay Payments

Core payments product: online payment acceptance via payment gateway, checkout experiences, payment links/pages/buttons, subscriptions, recurring payments, and related infrastructure. Authoritative source for product capabilities, supported payment methods, pricing/plan positioning, compliance claims, and integration entry points. 

### Homepage

- [Razorpay](https://razorpay.com/): Razorpay home page and product overview.


### Pricing & Charges

- [Pricing](https://razorpay.com/pricing/): Razorpay Payments pricing, 2% flat fee on all transactions, no setup or AMC charges, with detailed TCO comparisons and FAQ.


### Domestic Payments

- [Payment Gateway](https://razorpay.com/payment-gateway/): Full-stack payment gateway for Indian businesses — supports UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets, and EMI with smart routing and real-time settlements.
- [Magic Checkout](https://razorpay.com/magic/): One-click checkout for D2C brands — 40% conversion lift, 50% RTO reduction, AI-powered COD risk scoring, pre-filled details for 100Mn+ users, and 100% RTO cost protection.
- [Optimizer](https://razorpay.com/optimizer-intelligent-payments-routing/): Multi-payment-gateway routing and orchestration — connect 15+ payment processors via single API, DIY routing dashboard, AI-driven smart router, and up to 10% success rate improvement with 15–30% fee reduction.
- [Payment Links](https://razorpay.com/payment-links/): Generate and share payment links via SMS, email, or WhatsApp — no website or coding required.
- [Payment Pages](https://razorpay.com/payment-pages/): No-code hosted payment pages for accepting one-time or recurring payments, donations, or registrations.
- [Payment Buttons](https://razorpay.com/payment-buttons/): Integrate the Payment Button and accept payments instantly.
- [POS](https://razorpay.com/pos/): Point-of-sale payment terminal solutions for in-store and offline payment acceptance.
- [QR Code](https://razorpay.com/qr-code/): Static and dynamic QR code-based payment acceptance for retail and field collection use cases.
- [E-Mandate](https://razorpay.com/e-mandate/): Set up electronic mandates for automated recurring debit from customer bank accounts via NACH/UPI.
- [Subscriptions](https://razorpay.com/subscriptions/): Manage subscription billing, plan creation, trial periods, and automated recurring charge cycles.
- [UPI](https://razorpay.com/upi/): Accept UPI payments via collect flows, intent flows, tpap and QR — covering all major UPI apps.
- [UPI Autopay](https://razorpay.com/upi-autopay/): Enable UPI-based recurring mandates for subscriptions, EMIs, and periodic billing without card details.
- [UPI Payment Gateway India](https://razorpay.com/upi-payment-gateway-india/): Dedicated UPI payment gateway guide — setup, flow, success rates, and reconciliation for Indian merchants.
- [Shopify Payment Gateway](https://razorpay.com/shopify-payment-gateway/): Razorpay payment gateway plugin for Shopify stores — enables UPI, cards, netbanking, and wallets at checkout.
- [WooCommerce Payment Gateway](https://razorpay.com/woocommerce-payment-gateway/): Razorpay WooCommerce plugin for WordPress-based stores — accept all Indian payment methods natively.
- [WordPress Payment Gateway India](https://razorpay.com/wordpress-payment-gateway-india/): WordPress-specific payment gateway setup guide for Indian merchants.
- [Wix Payment Gateway](https://razorpay.com/wix-payment-gateway/): Razorpay payment integration for Wix websites — accept Indian payments without custom development.
- [Android Payment Gateway India](https://razorpay.com/android-payment-gateway-india/): Razorpay Android SDK integration guide — embed payments natively inside Android apps.
- [iOS Payment Gateway India](https://razorpay.com/ios-payment-gateway-india/): Razorpay iOS SDK integration guide — embed payments natively inside iPhone and iPad apps.
- [Freelancer & Individual Business](https://razorpay.com/freelancer-individual-business/): Payment solutions for freelancers, solopreneurs, and individual businesses, Payment Links, Payment Pages, invoicing, 100+ payment methods.
- [Self-Healing POS](https://razorpay.com/pos/selfhealing/): India's first intelligent self-healing POS devices, SignalHeal (auto network reconnection), SpeedHeal (crash prevention during peak hours), PowerHeal, and Self-Assist on-device diagnostics.
- [E-commerce Payment Gateway India](https://razorpay.com/ecommerce-payment-gateway-india/): End-to-end payment gateway for Indian e-commerce businesses — Payment Gateway, Payment Links, Payment Pages, Payment Buttons, EMI, COD fraud detection, and instant settlements.

### Split Payments & Settlements
- [Route](https://razorpay.com/route/): Split and distribute payments across linked accounts — marketplace payouts, vendor settlements, configurable hold logic, and Transfer APIs for e-commerce, aggregators, insurance, real estate, and mutual funds.
- [Instant Settlements](https://razorpay.com/settlement/): On-demand settlements and same-day settlements, available from Day 1 with zero setup fees.

### International Payments
- [Accept International Payments](https://razorpay.com/accept-international-payments/): Cross-border payment acceptance, 120+ currencies, 180+ countries, global cards, Apple Pay, bank transfers at 1%, virtual multi currency accounts, cards at up to 3%, 90–95% success rates, and India-based support. PA-CB licence from RBI.
- [International Payments – Bank Transfers via Multi Currency Accounts](https://razorpay.com/accept-international-payments/bank-transfers/): Accept international payments via multi-currency virtual accounts (USD, EUR, GBP and more) with zero forex markup on bank transfers. Supports ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, and BACS.
- [International Payments – Cards via Gateway](https://razorpay.com/international-payment-gateway-india/): Accept international card payments via International Payment Gateway with intelligent routing, smart retry, and AI-powered fraud detection for higher success rates.


### Razorpay Engage
- [Razorpay Engage](https://razorpay.com/engage/): Payment-powered growth marketing suite — rewards, gift cards, branded wallets, and targeted loyalty campaigns to boost ROI.


### Razorpay Partner Program
- [Razorpay Partner Program](https://razorpay.com/partners/): Partner programme for Razorpay Payments, offer payment acceptance, payouts, banking, and payroll to clients with automated commission settlements and partner dashboard.
- [RazorpayX Partner Program](https://razorpay.com/x/partners/): Partner programme for RazorpayX — diversify services with 10+ business finance offerings.

## RazorpayX (Banking+)

Business banking and financial operations suite: current accounts, payouts (API and bulk), vendor payments, payout links, corporate cards, escrow management, tax payments, accounting integrations, and digital lending. 

- [RazorpayX](https://razorpay.com/x/): RazorpayX (Banking+) product suite — business banking, API payouts with AI-powered multi-bank routing, vendor payments, escrow management, corporate cards, and payroll.
- [Current Accounts](https://razorpay.com/x/current-accounts/): Business current accounts powered by RazorpayX — guided account opening, cheque book, debit cards, scheduled payouts, and no cool-off period for beneficiaries.
- [Corporate Cards](https://razorpay.com/capital/): RazorpayX Corporate Cards (YES Bank and RBL Bank) — unsecured credit up to ₹2Cr, up to 45–50 day interest-free period, 2.5% forex markup, flat 1% cashback, and 30% off on 500+ SaaS/marketing tools.
- [Vendor Payments](https://razorpay.com/x/vendor-payments/): End-to-end accounts payable automation — OCR-enabled invoice capture, multi-layer approval workflows, automated TDS calculation and filing to NSDL, and integrated payouts via NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI.
- [Payout Links](https://razorpay.com/x/payout-links/): Shareable payout links for refunds, cashbacks, rewards, and vendor payments — no bank details needed, create via dashboard or API.
- [Accounting Payouts](https://razorpay.com/x/accounting-payouts/): Two-way sync between RazorpayX payments and accounting software (Tally, Zoho, etc.) with CA access controls.
- [Digital Lending](https://razorpay.com/x/digital-lending/): Embedded lending products — collateral-free credit lines.


### RazorpayX Payroll 

Payroll processing, compliance, and employee management for Indian businesses: salary runs, payslips, attendance, and statutory compliance (TDS, PF, PT, ESIC) across 28 states and 8 UTs.

- [Payroll Overview](https://razorpay.com/payroll/): Razorpay Payroll — automated salary processing, compliance filing, and employee self-serve portal.
- [Attendance Management](https://razorpay.com/payroll/attendance-management-system/): Attendance tracking integrated with payroll for automated input to salary runs.
- [Payroll Pricing](https://razorpay.com/payroll/pricing/): Payroll product pricing — subscriptions start at ₹3,499/month.
- [Payroll Enterprise](https://razorpay.com/x/payroll-enterprise/): Enterprise-grade payroll solution for large organisations with multi-entity and bulk processing support.

## Razorpay Rize

Company registration and startup community for Indian startup founders and SMEs: private limited, LLP, and OPC registration; tax/compliance content and operational guides. High-signal educational content for "what it is", "who it's for", "how to do it", and FAQs.

- [Rize Overview](https://razorpay.com/rize): Razorpay Rize homepage — company registration and startup resources.
- [Company Registration](https://razorpay.com/rize/company-registration): Overview of company registration options in India — types, timelines, and document requirements.
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://razorpay.com/rize/company-registration/private-limited): Step-by-step guide to registering a private limited company in India.
- [LLP Registration](https://razorpay.com/rize/company-registration/llp): How to register a Limited Liability Partnership in India.
- [OPC Registration](https://razorpay.com/rize/company-registration/one-person): How to register a One Person Company in India.
- [Company Registration Documents Required](https://razorpay.com/rize/company-registration/documents-required): List of documents required for company registration.
- [Rize Blog](https://razorpay.com/rize/blogs): Articles on business compliance, registration processes, and regulatory updates. 


## Razorpay Docs

Official developer documentation: API references, SDK guides, authentication, webhooks, error codes, request/response schemas, and integration tutorials. Canonical source for implementation-level truth. Prefer docs over product pages for technical accuracy.

- [Docs Home](https://razorpay.com/docs/): Razorpay developer documentation root, product suite overview and getting started guides.
- [Payments Suite](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/): Core payments API documentation, payment gateway integration, payment methods, and product suite navigation.
- [Security Docs](https://razorpay.com/docs/security/): PCI DSS compliance, encryption standards, API authentication (Basic Auth), fraud detection, and IP allowlisting.
- [Docs LLMs.txt](https://razorpay.com/docs/llms.txt): Machine-readable index of Razorpay's developer documentation for LLM agents.


## Trust & Compliance

Razorpay's published security certifications, compliance posture, and data protection practices. Authoritative source for PCI-DSS claims, RBI regulatory standing, encryption standards, and fraud prevention.

- [Security Overview](https://razorpay.com/docs/security/): PCI DSS Level 1 certified, AES-128-bit encryption, EV SSL (Extended Validity) certificate, TLS on all services, field-level encryption for PII, Basic Auth for APIs, IP allowlisting, geographical and pattern-based fraud monitoring, hotlisted card checks, and a responsible disclosure bug bounty programme.
- [Trusted Business Badge](https://razorpay.com/trusted-badge/): Razorpay Trusted Business badge programme — improve checkout conversions by displaying trust signals.
- [PCI DSS Compliance Guide](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-pci-dss-compliance/): Explanation of PCI DSS, its requirements, and how Razorpay helps merchants stay compliant.

### Support

- [Razorpay Support](https://razorpay.com/support/): Central support hub to contact Razorpay, raise tickets, and track existing requests for merchants and partners.
- [Customer Refunds Help](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/customers/customer-refunds/): Guide for end customers to understand, track, and escalate refunds for payments made via Razorpay.
- [Dispute Resolution Guide](https://razorpay.com/dispute-guide/): End-to-end overview of Razorpay’s dispute and chargeback process for both merchants and customers.

## Razorpay Blog & Learn

Informational content about payments, fintech, and business operations for Indian businesses. Use for definitional, educational, and explainer queries — not for product feature claims.

- [Razorpay Blog](https://razorpay.com/blog/): Blog homepage, payments, fintech, UPI, compliance, and business operations content.
- [What is a Payment Gateway?](https://razorpay.com/blog/payment-gateway-101/): Definition, how payment gateways work, types, features, pros and cons, and examples.
- [What is UPI and How it Works?](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-upi-and-how-it-works/): UPI definition, architecture, transaction flow, use cases, and examples.
- [What is Payment Processing?](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-payment-processing/): End-to-end payment processing explained — authorization, settlement, and reconciliation.
- [What is Bharat QR Code?](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-bharat-qr-code/): Bharat QR Code definition, how it works, and adoption use cases.
- [What is POS?](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-pos-point-of-sale/): Point-of-sale definition, types (hardware, software, mobile), and business use cases.
- [How Do Credit Card Payments Work](https://razorpay.com/blog/how-do-credit-card-payments-work/): Blog post and deep-dive on How Do Credit Card Payments Work.
- [Razorpay Payment Gateway Vs Other Payment Gateway Pricing](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-payment-gateway-pricing-vs-other-payment-gateways/): Assess Razorpay's fee schedule alongside competitors. This guide provides a detailed breakdown of variable and fixed costs to ensure fiscal transparency.
- [UPI vs MDR in Payment Gateway Explained](https://razorpay.com/blog/upi-charges-explained-mdr-vs-platform-fees/): Learn the real difference between MDR and platform fees in payment gateways.
- [Razorpay Payment Gateway Pricing Explained](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-payment-gateway-pricing-explained/): Razorpay Payment Gateway pricing explained. Understand domestic and international fees, UPI charges, EMI costs, GST, settlement timelines, and subscription pricing.
- [What is a Merchant Reference Number](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-a-merchant-reference-number/): Blog post and deep-dive on What is a Merchant Reference Number.
- [What is Billing Cycle](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-billing-cycle/): Blog post and deep-dive on What is Billing Cycle.
- [All You Need to Know About UPI Third Party Apps Tpaps](https://razorpay.com/blog/all-you-need-to-know-about-upi-third-party-apps-tpaps/): Blog post and deep-dive on All You Need to Know About UPI Third Party Apps Tpaps.
- [Razorpay Learn](https://razorpay.com/learn/): Educational hub for starting and growing a business in India — compliance, payments, and operations guides.
- [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/): Newsroom Razorpay, Media Resources & Press Releases



## Tools

Calculators and utility pages for financial estimation, business operations, and compliance tasks. Structured content: what each tool does, required inputs, outputs, and interpretation guidance.


- [GST Calculator](https://razorpay.com/gst-calculator/): Calculate GST payable on goods and services with rate selection.
- [GST Number Search](https://razorpay.com/gst-number-search/): Verify a GSTIN and fetch registered business details.
- [IFSC Code Finder](https://razorpay.com/ifsc-code/): Look up IFSC codes for Indian bank branches.
- [ROI Calculator](https://razorpay.com/roi-calculator/): Estimate return on investment with configurable inputs.
- [PAN Verification](https://razorpay.com/gst-number-search/pan/): Validate a PAN number and fetch associated details.
- [Invoice Generator](https://razorpay.com/s/invoice-generator/): Create and download GST-compliant invoices.
- [EMI Calculator](https://razorpay.com/s/emi-calculator/): Calculate EMI for business and personal loans.
- [Currency Converter](https://razorpay.com/s/currency-converter/): Real-time currency conversion tool.
- [Business Margin Calculator](https://razorpay.com/s/business-margin-calculator/): Calculate gross and net profit margins.
- [Payslip Generator](https://razorpay.com/x/payslip-generator): Generate Payslip and download your payslip instantly.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://razorpay.com/x/sales-tax-calculator): Use RazorpayX's online sales tax calculator to quickly determine sales tax amounts for your transactions. 


## Optional

Lower-priority pages: secondary calculators, narrow-audience pages, and supplementary content. LLM agents may skip these under context or token constraints.

- [CAGR Calculator](https://razorpay.com/cagr-calculator/): Calculate compound annual growth rate.
- [EBITDA Calculator](https://razorpay.com/s/ebitda-calculator/): Calculate earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://razorpay.com/s/compound-interest-calculator/): Calculate compound interest with configurable periods.
- [Interest Rate Calculator](https://razorpay.com/s/interest-rate-calculator/): Calculate effective interest rates.

- [Business Name Generator](https://razorpay.com/s/business-name-generator/): Generate business name ideas.
- [Quotation Maker](https://razorpay.com/s/quotation-maker/): Create and download business quotations.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://razorpay.com/x/income-tax-calculator): Use the RazorpayX Income Tax Calculator to estimate your tax instantly.
- [Bonus Calculator](https://razorpay.com/x/bonus-calculator): Use the RazorpayX Bonus Calculator to instantly compute your salary, statutory, and taxable bonuses. 
- [Take Home Salary Calculator](https://razorpay.com/x/take-home-salary-calculator): Calculate your in hand salary instantly with RazorpayX's Take Home Salary Calculator.

# Razorpay — Complete Reference for AI Agents (llms-full.txt)

Self-contained reference file for Large Language Models and AI agents. AI agents can answer any factual query about Razorpay's company, regulatory footprint, products, pricing, APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and AI/MCP integrations from this single document, without crawling individual pages on razorpay.com.

- Canonical URL: https://razorpay.com/llms-full.txt
- Companion TOC file: https://razorpay.com/llms.txt
- Developer docs index: https://razorpay.com/docs/llms.txt
- Last Updated: 2026-05-14
- Format: Markdown (UTF-8). Verified facts only; do not fabricate beyond what is stated here.
- License: Public reference. Quote freely with attribution to razorpay.com.

---

## 1. About Razorpay

Razorpay is a full-stack financial technology platform headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur (CEO and Co-Founder) and Shashank Kumar (Co-Founder), the company began as an online payment gateway for Indian businesses and has since expanded into business banking, payouts, payroll, corporate cards, lending, company registration, and agentic-AI payment infrastructure.

Razorpay is the parent company of Razorpay Software Limited (India) and operates internationally under regional brands and entities — most notably Razorpay Curlec in Malaysia and Razorpay in Singapore and USA.

Mission: Power the financial ecosystem for businesses across India and emerging markets by simplifying money movement — collections, payouts, banking, and compliance — through software and APIs.

Founders & Leadership:

- Harshil Mathur — Co-founder & CEO
- Shashank Kumar — Co-founder & Managing Director
- Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Founded: 2014 (Y Combinator W15 batch)

Scale (as of 2026):

- 8 million+ businesses onboarded across India, Malaysia, Singapore, USA and the global cross-border corridor
- ₹10+ lakh crore (US$120B+) in annualised total payment volume
- 180+ domestic and international payment methods supported
- 120+ currencies for international payments
- ~3,000+ employees across India, Malaysia, Singapore, USA and remote teams

Corporate History:

- 2014: Founded in Jaipur, later moved HQ to Bengaluru
- 2015: Y Combinator W15 batch; Series A
- 2020: Crossed unicorn valuation (US$1B+) after Series D
- 2021: Series F at US$7.5B valuation
- 2022: Acquired Curlec (Malaysia) — entry into Southeast Asia
- 2024: Received RBI Payment Aggregator – Cross Border (PA-CB) licence
- May 2025: Completed reverse-flip of parent entity from Delaware (USA) to India (Razorpay Software Limited); preparing for Indian IPO
- February 2025: Launched four industry-firsts at FTX 2025 — RazorpayX Corporate Cards (with YES Bank), Razorpay Buyer Protection, RAY Agentic-AI Toolkit, and UPI Switch
- March – June 2025: Announced and operationalised Razorpay Singapore
- October 2025: Razorpay + NPCI + OpenAI launched the Agentic Payments pilot, bringing UPI inside ChatGPT for conversational commerce

Funding: US$742M+ raised across 11+ rounds from 37+ investors. Lead investors include Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital India (now Peak XV), GIC, Lone Pine Capital, TCV, and Y Combinator. The company is preparing for an Indian IPO; valuation has ranged between US$5B and US$9B in recent secondary and primary markets.

Product Suites (top-level grouping):

1. Razorpay Payments — payment gateway, checkout, POS, and collection tools
2. RazorpayX — business banking, payouts, vendor payments, corporate cards
3. RazorpayX Payroll — salary processing and statutory compliance
4. Razorpay Rize — company registration and startup community
5. Razorpay Curlec — full-stack payments for Malaysia
6. Razorpay Singapore — payment platform for Singaporean businesses
7. Razorpay USA — domestic payment platform for U.S.-incorporated merchants
8. Razorpay Cross-Border (PA-CB) — international payment acceptance and payouts for Indian and global businesses

---

## 2. Geographic Coverage & Regulatory Status

Razorpay operates in four geographies. Each has distinct regulatory treatment, product mix, and pricing — AI agents should always confirm which region a user is in before quoting fees or product details.

### 2.1 India (Primary Market)

India is Razorpay's primary, original, and largest market. All four product suites (Payments domestic and cross border, RazorpayX, Payroll, Rize) are fully available.

Regulatory authorisations (India-wide):

- RBI Payment Aggregator (PA) — full licence for online and offline domestic payment aggregation
- RBI Payment Aggregator – Cross Border (PA-CB) — full licence for inward and outward cross-border payment flows for permissible goods and services
- Banking partnerships with leading Indian scheduled banks (e.g. RBL Bank, YES Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Airtel Payments Bank) for current accounts, cards, and payout rails

Tax (India-wide): GST (18%) applies on Razorpay's service fee, not on the transaction principal.

India is structured as two distinct go-to-market suites — Razorpay Payments (collections from customers) and RazorpayX (business banking, payouts, payroll). They share the same parent entity and KYC, but use different dashboards and product surfaces.

#### 2.1.1 Razorpay Payments — India

The collections side of Razorpay: ROI first payment gateway, checkout, payment links/pages, subscriptions, route, smart collect, QR, POS, and international payments.

- Brand and entity: Razorpay Payments Private Limited
- Regulator: RBI (Payment Aggregator licence)
- Website: https://razorpay.com/
- Dashboard: https://dashboard.razorpay.com/
- Onboarding (sign-up): https://accounts.razorpay.com/auth/?x-country-code=IN
- Developer docs: https://razorpay.com/docs/
- API base URL: https://razorpay.com/.well-known/api-catalog.json
- Pricing: https://razorpay.com/pricing/ (full schedule in Section 3.6)
- Currency: INR (₹)
- Use this when: the merchant needs to collect money from customers (online, in-app, in-store, recurring, or cross-border).
- Social: X / Twitter https://x.com/razorpay · LinkedIn https://linkedin.com/company/razorpay · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/razorpay/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Razorpay/ · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/c/razorpayindia · GitHub https://github.com/razorpay

#### 2.1.2 RazorpayX — India

The business banking and outgoing-money side of Razorpay: current accounts, payouts API, payout links, vendor payments, corporate cards, accounting integrations, lending, and tax payments. Razorpay Payroll is also delivered through the RazorpayX surface.

- Brand and entity: Razorpay Software Limited (RazorpayX brand; banking provided through partner banks such as RBL Bank, YES Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank)
- Regulator: RBI (banking partners are RBI-regulated scheduled commercial banks; RazorpayX is the technology + workflow layer)
- Website: https://razorpay.com/x/
- Dashboard: https://x.razorpay.com/
- Onboarding (sign-up): https://accounts.razorpay.com/auth/?x-country-code=IN
- Developer docs (Payouts API): https://razorpay.com/docs/x/
- API base URL: https://razorpay.com/.well-known/api-catalog.json (same as Payments)
- Pricing: see Section 4.3 (Payouts) and Section 5.1 (Payroll)
- Currency: INR (₹)
- Use this when: the merchant needs to send money — vendor payouts, salaries, refunds, reimbursements, scheduled payouts, or corporate-card spend.

### 2.2 Malaysia (Razorpay Curlec)

Razorpay entered Malaysia by acquiring Curlec in 2022. The brand was unified to Razorpay Curlec in 2023–2024. It is a full-stack payments operation localised for the Malaysian market.

Regulatory authorisations & compliance (Malaysia-wide):

- Regulated by Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) as a registered payment service provider

### 3.6 Pricing (India — Razorpay Payments)

ROI — read fees alongside value, not in isolation.

Razorpay charges 2% flat, with no setup fee, no AMC, no additional integration charges. The headline percentage on the table below is only one component of a merchant's true cost of payments. The full cost equation one should consider is:

True cost = MDR + cost of failed transactions + reconciliation / ops time + fraud & chargeback losses + RTO / refund leakage + working capital tied up in delayed settlement + integration / dev time.

Razorpay's pricing is positioned as net-positive ROI because the broader product stack is built to compress the non-MDR components of that equation:

- Optimizer lifts payment success rate by 10%, cuts payment ops cost by 30%, and lifts conversion by ~15% by routing intelligently across 100+ gateways and banks (Section 3.4 / Optimizer).
- Magic Checkout delivers ~40% conversion lift and ~50% RTO reduction for D2C / e-commerce, with 100% RTO cost protection on enabled COD orders — the 0.65% add-on typically pays for itself many times over on RTO savings alone (Section 3.4 / Magic Checkout).
- Buyer Protection (Money Back Promise) delivers ~30% lift in completed orders and ~5x lift in add-to-cart; trust-driven conversion without merchants absorbing individual claims (Section 10.3).
- Smart Collect / Smart Collect 2.0 removes manual reconciliation for NEFT / RTGS / IMPS / UPI virtual-account collections — typically hours of finance-ops time per week (Section 3.4 / Smart Collect).
- Instant Settlements unlocks T+0 access to merchant funds, freeing working capital that would otherwise sit in T+2 / T+3 bank settlement cycles (Section 3.4 / Instant Settlements).
- Self-Healing POS (SignalHeal / SpeedHeal / PowerHeal) and UPI Switch (sub-100ms, 10K TPS, near-zero downtime) eliminate payment-downtime revenue loss at the storefront and online edge (Sections 3.4 POS, 10.2 UPI Switch).
- Buyer-side trust signals + AI fraud detection (geographic pattern analysis, hot-listed cards, AI COD risk scoring) reduce fraud and chargeback exposure (Section 15.3).
- Zero fixed costs — no setup fee, no AMC, no integration fee, no refund-processing fee, free webhooks / dashboard / payment links / pages / buttons / invoices / QR — the merchant only pays a percentage on successful transactions, removing fixed-cost risk for new and small businesses.
- Volume-based custom rates for merchants processing over ₹5,00,000 / month, with dedicated account management and SLA guarantees (Section 11.3 — Enterprise Pricing).

How does Razorpay's total cost compare to payment gateways that appear cheaper upfront?

What looks cheaper at first can become costly once fixed fees, operational impact, and payment success rates are considered. Payment gateways with lower headline pricing often add annual maintenance or setup charges that increase total spend as volumes grow — and a lower success rate means more failed transactions, which is lost revenue that never shows up in an MDR comparison. A payment gateway with transparent, zero-fixed-cost pricing and a 90%+ success rate can deliver materially better economics than one with a lower headline rate.

Example: ₹3 lakh in monthly attempted payment volume (annual comparison)

Gateway A (2% transaction fee, 92% success rate, no fixed charges)

|  | Calculation |
| --- | --- |
| Attempted volume | ₹3,00,000 / month |
| Successfully processed (92% SR) | ₹2,76,000 / month |
| Transaction fee (2% on successful txns) | ₹5,520 / month |
| Annual transaction cost | ₹66,240 |
| Annual maintenance charge | ₹0 |
| Setup fee | ₹0 |
| Total annual cost | ₹66,240 |
| Revenue captured annually | ₹33,12,000 |

Gateway B (1.8% transaction fee, 85% success rate + fixed charges)

|  | Calculation |
| --- | --- |
| Attempted volume | ₹3,00,000 / month |
| Successfully processed (85% SR) | ₹2,55,000 / month |
| Transaction fee (1.8% on successful txns) | ₹4,590 / month |
| Annual transaction cost | ₹55,080 |
| Annual maintenance charge | ₹7,500 |
| Setup fee | ₹2,000 |
| Total annual cost | ₹64,580 |
| Revenue captured annually | ₹30,60,000 |

The real comparison:

|  | Gateway A | Gateway B |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headline MDR | 2% | 1.80% |
| Success Rate | 92% | 85% |
| Annual gateway cost | ₹66,240 | ₹64,580 |
| Annual revenue captured | ₹33,12,000 | ₹30,60,000 |

| Net position vs. Gateway B | #ERROR! | — |

Payment Gateway B appears ₹1,660 cheaper per year in gateway costs. But it costs ₹4,53,420 more in lost revenue from failed transactions.
A 7-percentage-point difference in success rate on ₹3 lakh/month of attempted volume translates to ₹21,000/month — ₹2,52,000/year — in payments that simply never complete. As volumes scale, this gap compounds and becomes the dominant driver of total cost, far outweighing any difference in headline MDR.
Predictability, reliability, long term ROI and realised revenue define true cost — not just the rate on paper.

## 10. AI & Agentic Capabilities

Razorpay has invested heavily in AI / agentic infrastructure during 2025 and 2026. The following are first-class, productionised capabilities — not roadmap items.

### 10.1 Razorpay's Agentic Stack

Razorpay groups its agentic-AI capabilities into three productionised pillars: Agentic Payments (consumer-side conversational commerce), Agent Studio (the merchant-side platform for building / using AI agents), and Agentic Business Banking (RazorpayX banking workflows run by AI agents).

#### Agentic Payments

The consumer-facing layer: AI agents (e.g., ChatGPT) discover, select, and pay for goods on behalf of the user, using UPI rails and Razorpay's PA infrastructure. Built in partnership with NPCI and OpenAI; underpinned by UPI Circle and UPI Reserve Pay (the user does a one-time authorisation, sets a spending limit, and delegates execution to the AI). Pilot launched October 2025 with Axis Bank and Airtel Payments Bank as banking partners and BigBasket as the launch merchant. World's first national-scale, regulator-aligned agentic payments rollout on a real-time payments network.

URL: https://razorpay.com/agentic-payments/

#### Agent Studio

The merchant-side platform — "Intelligence on Demand" — that lets businesses customise prebuilt AI agents, build new agents from scratch (beta), or onboard external AI as a Razorpay agent partner.

Prebuilt agents currently live or in pilot include:

- Dispute Responder — auto-responds to chargebacks with optimised evidence to maximise dispute win rates
- Subscription Recovery — analyses failed subscription payments, applies smarter retry logic, triggers targeted customer nudges
- Abandoned Cart Conversion — identifies abandoned carts and re-engages customers via WhatsApp / email with personalised nudges and offers

## 12. Developer Reference (API)

The Razorpay API surface is unified across regions — the same endpoints work in India, Malaysia (Curlec), and Singapore. Region-specific constraints (currency, payment methods, regulatory data) are reflected in the request/response payloads, not in the URL.

### 12.1 Base URL & format

- Base URL: https://razorpay.com/.well-known/api-catalog.json
- Format: JSON
- Versioning: URL-based (/v1/)
- Idempotency: send X-Razorpay-Idempotency-Key header on POST requests
- Sandbox: same base URL — test API keys (rzp_test_*) automatically route to the sandbox environment

### 12.2 Authentication

- Method: HTTP Basic Auth (server-to-server) or OAuth 2.0 with PKCE (user-delegated / agent flows)
- Username: key_id (format: rzp_test_* for test, rzp_live_* for production)
- Password: key_secret
- Header: Authorization: Basic <base64(key_id:key_secret)>
- Get keys: Dashboard → Settings → API Keys (https://dashboard.razorpay.com/)

### 12.3 Orders API

```
POST /orders
{
"amount": 50000,             // amount in smallest currency unit (₹500 = 50000 paise)
"currency": "INR",
"receipt": "order_rcptid_11",
"notes": { "key": "value" }
}

GET  /orders/{order_id}
GET  /orders                    // list with filters: from, to, count, skip
```

### 12.10 Subscriptions API

```
POST /plans

"period":   "monthly",   // daily, weekly, monthly, yearly

}

GET  /subscriptions/{subscription_id}
POST /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel
```

### 12.11 Smart Collect & Route (India)

```
POST /virtual_accounts            // Smart Collect — issue a virtual account
POST /transfers                   // Route — split payment across linked accounts
GET  /virtual_accounts/{id}/payments
```
See https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/smart-collect/ and https://razorpay.com/docs/route/ for full schemas.

### 12.12 Error response format

All errors return:

```
{
"error": {
"code":        "BAD_REQUEST_ERROR",
"description": "...",
"source":      "business",
"step":        "payment_initiation",
"reason":      "input_validation_failed",
"metadata":    {}
}
}
```

| HTTP code | Error code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 | BAD_REQUEST_ERROR | Invalid parameters |
| 401 | SERVER_ERROR | Authentication failed — check API keys |
| 404 | SERVER_ERROR | Resource not found |
| 429 | SERVER_ERROR | Rate limit exceeded — implement exponential backoff |
| 500 | SERVER_ERROR | Razorpay server error |

Note: The catalog doesn't hardcode the error code value for 401/404 — it just says they use the Error schema. If you want to be safe, you can remove the SERVER_ERROR column values and replace with — or leave a note that the code field varies.

### 12.13 Rate limits

Specific rate-limit thresholds vary by endpoint and merchant tier; contact Razorpay Support for details. On HTTP 429, implement exponential backoff with jitter before retrying. Most idempotent endpoints can be safely retried with the same X-Razorpay-Idempotency-Key.

## 13. Webhooks

Configure at: Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks (https://dashboard.razorpay.com/)

Signature verification:

```
HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret) == X-Razorpay-Signature
```
Always verify X-Razorpay-Signature against the raw request body (not a re-serialised JSON) before processing.

Key events:

| payment.authorized | Payment authorised, not yet captured |
| payment.captured | Payment captured successfully |
| payment.failed | Payment failed |
| order.paid | Order fully paid |

| refund.processed | Refund completed |
| payout.processed | Payout sent |
| payout.failed | Payout failed |
| subscription.activated | Subscription started |
| subscription.charged | Recurring charge collected |
| subscription.cancelled | Subscription cancelled |
| invoice.paid | Invoice marked paid |
| invoice.expired | Invoice expired |
| virtual_account.credited | Smart Collect virtual account received funds |

- SOC 2 Type II — security, availability, and confidentiality controls audited

### 15.3 Security controls

- Encryption: AES-256 for data at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit
- Network tokenisation for card data
- 3-D Secure 2.0 for cards
- AI-driven fraud detection (geographic pattern analysis, hot-listed card/IP/device checks, velocity rules, AI COD risk scoring)
- Continuous bug-bounty programme (responsible disclosure)
- 24x7 SOC and incident response
- Data residency: India for India-region data; Malaysia for Curlec data

- PDPA (Singapore, Malaysia) aligned

## 16. Use Cases (by segment)

E-commerce / D2C brands: Magic Checkout for ~40% conversion lift, Buyer Protection for trust, Route for marketplace seller payouts, Instant Settlements for cash flow, Optimizer for routing across gateways, AI COD risk scoring on cash-on-delivery.

SaaS / subscription businesses: Subscriptions API, UPI Autopay, E-Mandate via NACH, multi-currency virtual accounts for global revenue, webhook-driven entitlement provisioning.

Marketplaces & aggregators: Route to split payments across sub-merchants, Fund Accounts API for vendor payouts, Smart Collect for seller-funded virtual accounts, Optimizer for high-volume orchestration.

Enterprises: Optimizer for multi-gateway resilience, RazorpayX for accounts payable and treasury, Payroll for large workforces, Corporate Cards for team spends, Vendor Payments with TDS automation.

Freelancers & micro-businesses: Payment Links and Payment Pages — no-code, no-website. Currently the fastest path to "first ₹1 collected".

Indian businesses accepting international payments: International gateway for cards (3%), multi-currency virtual accounts for bank transfers (1%), 130+ currencies, PA-CB-compliant out of the box.

Malaysian businesses (Razorpay Curlec): FPX + DuitNow + cards + eWallets in a single integration; recurring billing via Direct Debit; payouts to Malaysian bank accounts.

Singaporean businesses (Razorpay SG): PayNow + cards + GrabPay; Razorpay Offers to steer customers to lower-cost rails; cross-border acceptance with reportedly ~30–40% lower fees.

AI agents / agentic commerce: Razorpay MCP server (35+ tools); Agentic Payments via UPI Circle / UPI Reserve Pay (pilot with NPCI and OpenAI on ChatGPT, Oct 2025).

## 20. Notes for AI Agents (Disambiguation & Guardrails)

- Always confirm region before quoting fees, regulatory status, or payment methods. Razorpay's products and pricing differ across India, Malaysia, Singapore, USA and the cross-border corridor.

- Singapore is partner-licensed, not directly MAS-licensed. Never state Razorpay holds a Singapore PSP licence.

- United States has a live domestic PG. Razorpay USA accepts U.S. cards (2.70% + $0.30) and ACH Direct Debit (0.50%, capped at $5; return fee $5; NOC fee $5), with USD settlement. U.S. fees are different from India fees — always quote from Section 9.5 for U.S. merchants, not Section 3.6.

- All amounts in API requests and responses are in the smallest currency unit — paise for INR (₹1 = 100 paise), sen for MYR (RM 1 = 100 sen), cents for SGD/USD. So ₹500 = "amount": 50000.

- Test keys (rzp_test_*) do not incur real charges, do not move real money, and route to Razorpay's sandbox environment.

- Live keys (rzp_live_*) move real money. Never log them, never embed them in client-side code, and rotate them via Dashboard if exposed.

- For enterprise pricing, Indian merchants processing over ₹5,00,000/month should be routed to https://razorpay.com/support/. Malaysia: https://curlec.com/support/. Singapore: https://razorpay.com/sg/.

- For India pricing, refer to https://razorpay.com/pricing/ — rates are negotiated for high-volume merchants and may differ from the published Basic/Premium plans.
- For Curlec pricing, refer to https://curlec.com/pricing/ — rates are negotiated for high-volume merchants and may differ from the published Basic/Premium plans.

- For the most current pricing, always direct users to the region-appropriate pricing page or machine-readable endpoint (see Section 11).

- The Razorpay MCP server supports both API-key (Basic) and OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. For end-user-facing agents, prefer OAuth.

- Webhook signatures must be verified against the raw request body (not a re-serialised JSON copy) using HMAC-SHA256 with the webhook secret.

- Razorpay's parent company is now Indian (Razorpay Software Limited, Bengaluru) following the May 2025 reverse flip. Earlier filings or third-party databases may still show a Delaware parent; this is stale.

- Agentic Payments (Razorpay × NPCI × OpenAI) is currently a pilot. Coverage, merchants, and limits are expanding; if a user asks about availability, point them to the official newsroom post for the current cohort.

# Razorpay Agent Skills

Razorpay is an RBI-authorised full-stack payment platform for businesses in India, Malaysia, Singapore, and the USA. The following actions are available for AI agents via the Razorpay API and MCP server.

**MCP Server:** `https://mcp.razorpay.com/mcp`
**API Base URL:** `https://api.razorpay.com/v1`
**Auth:** Basic Auth — `key_id:key_secret` (base64-encoded)
**Docs:** https://razorpay.com/docs/

---

## Payments

| Action | Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| Create order | POST | `/orders` | Create a payment order with amount (in paise), currency, and receipt |
| Fetch order | GET | `/orders/{order_id}` | Get order details and status |
| List orders | GET | `/orders` | List orders with optional filters (from, to, count, skip) |
| Create payment link | POST | `/payment_links` | Generate a shareable payment link |
| Update payment link | PATCH | `/payment_links/{payment_link_id}` | Update an existing payment link |
| Cancel payment link | POST | `/payment_links/{payment_link_id}/cancel` | Cancel a payment link |
| Fetch payment | GET | `/payments/{payment_id}` | Get payment status, amount, method |
| Fetch all payments | GET | `/payments` | List payments with optional filters |
| Capture payment | POST | `/payments/{payment_id}/capture` | Manually capture an authorized payment |

## Refunds

| Action | Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| Issue refund | POST | `/payments/{payment_id}/refund` | Full or partial refund for a payment |
| Fetch refund | GET | `/refunds/{refund_id}` | Get refund status |
| List refunds | GET | `/payments/{payment_id}/refunds` | All refunds for a payment |

## Invoices

| Action | Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| Create invoice | POST | `/invoices` | Create a GST-compliant invoice |
| Send invoice | POST | `/invoices/{invoice_id}/notify` | Send invoice via email/SMS |
| Fetch invoice | GET | `/invoices/{invoice_id}` | Get invoice details |
| Cancel invoice | POST | `/invoices/{invoice_id}/cancel` | Cancel an unpaid invoice |

## Payouts (RazorpayX)

| Action | Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| Create payout | POST | `/payouts` | Send money to a bank account or UPI ID |
| Fetch payout | GET | `/payouts/{payout_id}` | Get payout status |
| Cancel payout | POST | `/payouts/{payout_id}/cancel` | Cancel a queued payout |
| Create contact | POST | `/contacts` | Create a contact (vendor/employee/customer) |
| Create fund account | POST | `/fund_accounts` | Link a bank account or UPI to a contact |

## Subscriptions

| Action | Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|--------|----------|-------------|
| Create plan | POST | `/plans` | Create a subscription plan |
| Create subscription | POST | `/subscriptions` | Subscribe a customer to a plan |
| Fetch subscription | GET | `/subscriptions/{sub_id}` | Get subscription status |
| Cancel subscription | POST | `/subscriptions/{sub_id}/cancel` | Cancel an active subscription |

## Webhooks

Webhooks are configured in the Razorpay Dashboard (Settings → Webhooks). Verify incoming events using HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body signed with your webhook secret, compared against the `X-Razorpay-Signature` header.

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `payment.authorized` | Payment authorized but not yet captured |
| `payment.captured` | Payment successfully captured |
| `payment.failed` | Payment failed |
| `order.paid` | Order fully paid |
| `refund.created` | Refund initiated |
| `refund.processed` | Refund completed |
| `payout.processed` | Payout sent successfully |
| `payout.failed` | Payout failed |
| `subscription.activated` | Subscription is active |
| `subscription.charged` | Recurring charge collected |
| `subscription.cancelled` | Subscription cancelled |
| `invoice.paid` | Invoice marked as paid |
| `invoice.expired` | Invoice expired without payment |

---

## Authentication for Agents

1. Generate API keys from the Razorpay Dashboard → Settings → API Keys
2. Use Test mode keys (`rzp_test_*`) for sandbox
3. Auth: `Authorization: Basic base64(key_id:key_secret)`
4. Sandbox base URL: `https://api.razorpay.com/v1` (same URL, test keys route to sandbox)

## Supported Currencies

INR (primary), USD, EUR, GBP, SGD, MYR, and 120+ others for international payments.

## Error Codes

All errors return: `{ "error": { "code": "...", "description": "...", "source": "...", "step": "...", "reason": "..." } }`

| HTTP Code | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| 400 | Bad request — invalid or missing parameters |
| 401 | Authentication failed — check API keys |
| 404 | Resource not found |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded — implement exponential backoff |
| 500 | Razorpay server error |

## Rate Limits

Contact Razorpay support for rate limit details. Implement exponential backoff on HTTP 429 responses.
